description: Start a dated run of a purchase-requisition and return its RUN-YYYY-NNNN id. Steps are COPIED into the run, so editing the purchase-requisition later never changes a run under way. Runs are free, never capped.

date.description: The day the run happened, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

purchaseRequisition.description: The purchase-requisition id, e.g. CL-0001, or its name when only one carries it

reference.description: The job, order or asset id this run belongs to, e.g. WO-2026-0044. Named only; no sibling store is opened

title.description: What this run is against, e.g. Van BX21 KLM, February service

name: run_start
title: Start a run of a purchase-requisition
